subject: Compact demo window negotiation — Brightline Payments
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlinepay.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlinepay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 08:13:00 -0400
Subject: Compact demo window negotiation — Brightline Payments

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to walk through how Redwood can cut per-token latency and cost for Brightline's payout pipeline. I want to flag a scheduling constraint up front: our EU infra & engineering SMEs are only available in the late CET afternoon (their local evenings), and I know Brightline prefers not to run demos after 8pm local. With DST differences coming up in October we want to avoid any confusion and pick a compact slot that works across teams.

Options I can offer this week: 
- 30 min compact demo: 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST (tight walkthrough + Q&A)
- 45 min regular demo: 13:00 ET / 19:00 CEST (EU engineer will be late evening)
- 60 min split: 10:00 ET demo + recorded follow-up deep-dive with engineers the next day

If you absolutely need earlier ET (before 10am) we can do that but we would record and schedule a short follow-up office-hours window for the EU engineers to join.

Attached is a short agenda and the deployment diagram so you can see the level of operational detail we'll cover. Please let me know which option you prefer and whether you want the recording & a follow-up deep-dive with infra.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo_agenda.pdf (PDF), deployment_diagram.png (image)
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlinepay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlinepay.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact demo window negotiation — Brightline Payments

Laura — thanks.

We can't do anything later than 6pm CEST on our side (regulatory team blocks evenings), so the 17:00 CEST / 11:00 ET option looks promising. A couple quick asks:
- Can you confirm recording will be available? Our infra folks won't all be present and need an async copy.
- If we pick the 30-min compact option, please call out which sections you will skip (we need the latency/cost demo + KV-cache behavior).

If 11:00 ET is workable for Redwood's EU engineer, let's lock it. If not, propose the split option and we'll follow async.

—Samir
Samir Patel | Head of Platform, Brightline Payments
samir@brightlinepay.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@brightlinepay.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact demo window negotiation — Brightline Payments

Looping in Jonas (EU infra lead) for host availability. Quick proposal to keep this single session and avoid extra handoffs:

Plan A (preferred): 45-minute compact run at 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST — we will prioritize: 1) targeted latency/cost snapshot (15 min), 2) short architecture + KV-cache play (15 min), 3) 15-min Q&A. Jonas will join remotely; the EU engineer will be on-call but can dial in earlier for setup. We will record.

Plan B (fallback): 30-minute focused demo at 11:00 ET focused only on latency & cost, plus a separate 30-minute deep-dive office-hours with engineers at 08:00 ET the following day (recorded for compliance).

Jonas — can you confirm you or an EU SME can be on the call at 17:00 CEST? If not, we'll go Plan B and I will coordinate the post-demo office-hours.

Thanks,
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlinepay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact demo window negotiation — Brightline Payments

Thanks, everyone — 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST works for us. We prefer the 45-minute compact run so we get a full picture in one session. Please send a calendar invite in ET with the CEST time noted and confirm recording.

Note: our team also flagged the October DST change across regions; if we end up rescheduling after mid-October, please double-check the local time conversion — we once had a 1-hour slip when CET switched.

Laura — can you send the invite and include the recording permission for external attendees?

Best,
Elena Ruiz | Product Ops, Brightline Payments
elena@brightlinepay.com | +44 20 7946 0123
